pokedexEntries.su: This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

pokedexEntries.us: This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

pokedexEntries.um: This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap. Since the cap’s not the right size, the fit is a bit loose.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is brimming with memories of when they first met.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap. The cap is a precious symbol of a fateful encounter.
